mutations.name: B05-list-filter
mutations.old: access p required row && requestedAllowed requested row && visible p requested projectListing row
mutations.new: true && requestedAllowed requested row && visible p requested projectListing row

mutations.name: B05-scope
mutations.old: decide (required ∈ p.scopes) && decide (row.owner = p.user) && projectAllowed p row.project
mutations.new: true && decide (row.owner = p.user) && projectAllowed p row.project

mutations.name: B05-owner
mutations.old: decide (required ∈ p.scopes) && decide (row.owner = p.user) && projectAllowed p row.project
mutations.new: decide (required ∈ p.scopes) && true && projectAllowed p row.project

mutations.name: B05-project
mutations.old: decide (required ∈ p.scopes) && decide (row.owner = p.user) && projectAllowed p row.project

mutations.name: B05-empty-selection
mutations.new: | some ids => if ids.isEmpty then true else decide (project ∈ ids)

mutations.name: B05-question-response
mutations.old: ⟨true, some submitted, { s with savedInputs := s.savedInputs ++ [submitted] }⟩
mutations.new: ⟨true, some target.privateData, { s with savedInputs := s.savedInputs ++ [submitted] }⟩
